name: euv-diffractometry-data
title: Lab-based Multi-wavelength EUV Diffractometry Data for Critical Dimension Metrology
description: This dataset contains measurement and simulation data from lab-based multi-wavelength extreme ultra-violet (EUV) diffractometry experiments for critical dimension metrology in semiconductor manufacturing. The data is stored in CSV files named according to the pattern LxxPyyy_zz.csv, where xx represents line width (nm), yyy represents pitch (nm), and zz represents rotation angle (degrees). Each file contains diffraction efficiencies for various orders and harmonics (21st to 31st), along with their standard deviations, normalized by the 0th order.

sources.title: README: Measurement and simulation data from Lab-based multi-wavelength extreme ultra-violet diffractometry
